subject: Contract playbook + demo — coordination and legal touchpoint
body:
From: Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearvista.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor kickoff + legal redline / demo availability

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro last week. Our procurement and legal teams are aligned to move forward but want a short legal redline call ahead of any product demo so Counsel can confirm high-level terms. We also want a parallel onboarding/demo check so our Platform and ML teams can see performance claims in context.

Can we do the following this week:
- Legal-only: 30 minutes (high level, redline walk through)
- Product demo + onboarding Q&A: 45 minutes (technical, integrate/hosting model)

Our availability (PDT):
- Tue 5/25: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 5/26: 09:00–12:00

I’ll loop in Procurement (procurement@clearvista.com). If you can propose a specific sequence (legal first or demo first) we’ll lock it. Also attaching our standard PO requirements doc — procurement will expect this on the first call.

Thanks,
Sara Moss
Sr. Procurement Manager
ClearVista Inc.
Attachment: ClearVista_PO_requirements.pdf

-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff + legal redline / demo availability

Sara — really appreciate the clear windows. We can do both; recommended flow is legal first (30m) to clear any must-not-ship terms, then a 45m product session immediately after so engineering can ask about private deployment options and evidence (SOC2, audit logs).

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue 5/25: Legal 10:30–11:00, Demo 11:05–11:50
- Wed 5/26: Legal 09:15–09:45, Demo 09:50–10:35

Laura (legal) and Marissa (onboarding) are on copy. I’m attaching a short product brief to give your Platform team context ahead of the demo.

If any of those are tight, happy to offer Tue 15:15–16:00 for a single combined block instead.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-ds.pdf

-----
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearvista.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: proposed MSA edits (first pass)

Forwarding our first-pass redline. Prefer a 30-minute legal session to walk the clauses that matter to us (data-use, subprocessing, audit rights, indemnity carve-outs). We’re not looking to re-open everything but want to flag a few areas.

Please propose a call before the demo — counsel prefers to review the redline first.

Tom Reynolds
Associate General Counsel
ClearVista Inc.
Attachment: proposed-MSA-markup.docx

-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearvista.com>, Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: proposed MSA edits (first pass) — scheduling legal + demo

Tom — thanks for sending the redline. Laura from our legal team will take the lead on the clause responses; Marissa will run the onboarding/demo logistics.

To keep momentum, can we lock:
- Legal touch (30m): Wed 5/26 09:15–09:45 PDT
- Product demo (45m): Wed 5/26 09:50–10:35 PDT

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-clearvista-demo-20270527
DocuSign preview (MSA for reference): https://docusign.com/CLV-4982-msa

If that works for you, I’ll send invites to the broader stakeholder list. If counsel still prefers Tue we can flip to Tue 10:30/11:05 — let me know.

Jordan

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearvista.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re: proposed MSA edits (first pass) — scheduling legal + demo

Tom, Jordan — I reviewed the doc quickly. Two quick asks before the legal call so we can be prepared:
1) Can you confirm whether ClearVista requires audit-log access for our private deployment (or just periodic reports)? If it's audit-log access we need to align on scopes and retention.
2) Please confirm which SOC2 attachments you expect (Type II latest report + any carve-outs). If you have a shared drive link to evidence, please share ahead of the call.

Also — for scheduling: if the Wed 09:15 slot is locked, Laura will be on the call and can give clause-level responses; if counsel prefers Tue, request sent.

Laura Bennett
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
-----
On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 09:34 AM Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearvista.com> wrote:
> Forwarding our first-pass redline. Prefer a 30-minute legal session to walk the clauses that matter to us (data-use, subprocessing, audit rights, indemnity carve-outs). We’re not looking to re-open everything but want to flag a few areas.
>
> Tom Reynolds
> Associate General Counsel
> ClearVista Inc.
> Attachment: proposed-MSA-markup.docx

-----
From: Sara Moss <sara.moss@clearvista.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@clearvista.com>, procurement@clearvista.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract playbook + demo — coordination and legal touchpoint

Jordan / Team — Wed 5/26 works for us but one small change: procurement needs a 5-minute alignment with Marissa right before the demo to confirm PO flow and billing contacts. Can we shift the product demo start to 09:55 so procurement can triage at 09:50?

Proposed final cadence (PDT):
- Legal: 09:15–09:45 (Laura + Tom + Jordan)
- Procurement quick align: 09:50–09:55 (procurement@clearvista.com + Marissa)
- Product demo: 09:55–10:40

Attached our PO requirements referenced earlier. I’ll send procurement contact names separately. See you all Wednesday.

Cheers,
Sara Moss
Sr. Procurement Manager
ClearVista Inc.
Attachment: ClearVista_PO_requirements.pdf

-----
Reply thread status: Confirmed slots; internal next steps: Laura to prepare clause notes, Marissa to send pre-demo checklist and pre-reads, Jordan to finalize calendar invites and include Zoom link and the DocuSign preview.
